heading: top-split
name: 交替底色直列卡＋側邊圖片引導卡
desc: 兩張等高卡片並排：寬的左卡放標題組與一份以交替底色區分的直列，窄的右卡以圖片為背景，置中放小圖示、標題與按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。內容對齊頁面內容寬度，左右並排兩張等高的卡片：左卡約佔三分之二寬，右卡約佔三分之一寬。左卡上方放標題組：標題靠左，按鈕靠右；標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，沒有時省略。標題組下方是多個項目排成的直列，每列一筆，橫向依序放次要文字、小標籤與說明文字（可多行），三者垂直置中；列與列之間沒有間距，也沒有分隔線，改以相鄰列的底色交替區分；直列下方到卡片下緣留一段空白。右卡以圖片為背景填滿整張卡片，內容水平與垂直都置中，由上而下放小圖示、小標籤、標題與按鈕，小圖示與小標籤沒有時省略。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊，左卡內容在上、右卡在下。左卡改為滿版底色區，左右貼齊畫面邊緣、不再留邊；標題組只留小標籤與標題並靠左，原本靠右的按鈕移到直列下方，按鈕橫跨整欄。每列改為左側次要文字在上、小標籤在下，右側放說明文字；交替底色與列之間沒有間距的做法不變。右卡在滿版底色區下方，與它隔一段空白，仍對齊頁面內容寬度、留邊，外形接近方形，內容仍置中。

en.name: Zebra-striped list card + side image card
en.desc: Two equal-height cards side by side: a wide left card with a heading group and a list whose rows are distinguished by alternating background tints, and a narrow right card with an image background holding a centered small icon, title and button.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The content is aligned to the page content width, with two equal-height cards side by side: the left card is about two thirds of the width and the right card about one third. At the top of the left card is the heading group, with the title on the left and a button on the right; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above; omit it when there is no content. Below the heading group is a list of rows made of multiple items, one item per row, each row placing secondary text, a label and a description (may wrap to multiple lines) horizontally in that order, all three vertically centered; there is no gap between rows and no divider, and adjacent rows are distinguished by alternating background tints; space is left between the list and the bottom edge of the card. The right card uses an image as its background filling the whole card, with its content centered both horizontally and vertically: from top to bottom a small icon, a label, a title and a button; omit the small icon and label when there is no content.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The layout becomes a vertical stack, with the left card's content on top and the right card below. The left card becomes a full-bleed background area, flush with the left and right edges of the screen with no margin; its heading group keeps only the label and title, aligned left, and the button that was on the right moves below the list, spanning the full column. Each row now places the secondary text above the label on the left, with the description on the right; the alternating background tints and the absence of gaps between rows stay the same. The right card sits below the full-bleed area, separated from it by some space, still aligned to the page content width with a margin, roughly square in shape, with its content still centered.
